# Four.meme Classic parity (R12, 2026-11-04): read-only BSC mainnet (chain 56) through the free archive endpoint
# https://bsc-mainnet.public.blastapi.io (eth_call, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_getStorageAt only),
# by one-off scripts of the BSC session (not in the repository); every row names its block and the calls below, so each
# is re-checkable against any archive node. Addresses are written with all 40 hex digits (normalized: a capture's
# integer formatting had dropped a leading zero once).
# TokenManager2 0x5c952063c7fc8610ffdb798152d69f0b9550762b (its EIP-1967 implementation at each block: IMPL rows; blocks
# 129906195/6 the implementation of the G0.1 freeze, the others the current one), Helper3 0xf251f83e40a78868fcfa3fa4599dad6494e46034.
# The launches: those among the 40 newest tokens of _tokens(i) at block 131530023 (i = 2248746 down; 36 rows, the 4
# launched through another contract have none), the G0.1 fixture token 0xbe57...ffff and three tokens of other
# creator-buy words.
# LAUNCHED token block: the launch block (_tokenInfoEx1s.blockNumber) of a probed token without a LAUNCH row (older
# tokens of the priced word, _tokens(i) for i = 2248706 - 400k).
# IMPL block implementation
# LAUNCH block tx token msg.value K quote feeSetting amount cost fee offers funds calldata
#   K and quote (_tokenInfos), feeSetting (_tokenInfoEx1s) at the launch block; amount..funds the receipt's TokenPurchase
#   (the creator's BUY inside createToken; '-' none); calldata the launch transaction's input.
# BUY block token K T offers tradingFeeRate minTradingFee funds amount cost fee msgValue approval amountFunds
#   Helper3.tryBuy(token, 0, funds) at the block: estimatedAmount, estimatedCost, estimatedFee, amountMsgValue,
#   amountApproval, amountFunds (the payment the call needs); the state _tokenInfos and
#   Helper3.getTokenInfo at the same block (tokens on the curve with the native quote only).
# SELL block token K T offers tradingFeeRate minTradingFee amount funds fee
#   Helper3.trySell(token, amount) at the block: funds (to the seller), fee.
# PROBE block token template feeSetting K T offers tradingFeeRate minTradingFee funds tokens spent soldFor atTokens aboveTokens
#   Executed by eth_call on the block's end state with a state override (nothing signed or sent; no third-party account):
#   a probe contract (code and balance overridden at 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000d4b02, called from
#   0x...0d4b01) calls TokenManager2 buyTokenAMAP{value: funds}(token, funds, 1) with the encoder's calldata, then
#   sellToken(token, tokens) after approve(TokenManager2, tokens); tokens = its token balance, spent = the wei it lost,
#   soldFor = the wei the SELL returned (the SELL leaves no token). atTokens/aboveTokens: the same BUY with minAmount =
#   tokens and tokens + 1 (OK executed, REVERT reverted). State: _tokenInfos (template, K, T, offers), _tokenInfoEx1s
#   (feeSetting), Helper3.getTokenInfo (fee terms) at the block. Fresh tokens, their launch blocks, and older tokens of
#   the priced word (LAUNCHED rows).
# EXEC block index tx token status event amount cost fee offers funds msg.value calldata K T offers tradingFeeRate minTradingFee quote
#   Every direct call to TokenManager2 of buyTokenAMAP(address,uint256,uint256) or sellToken(address,uint256[,uint256]) the
#   scans met (EXEC scan lines), its receipt's TokenPurchase or TokenSale (offers and funds after it), its input; K, T,
#   offers and quote _tokenInfos at the end of the block (T - offers is constant per token), the fee terms
#   Helper3.getTokenInfo. No launch block of the LAUNCH rows holds a direct call after the launch: their buyers call
#   through other contracts.
# EXEC scan: blocks 131529723 down to 131525724, every direct trade call (selectors met: 87f27655, 3e11741f; a reverted call has no
#   event), and before it blocks 131530023 down to at least 131529785 (the same selectors).
